name: memory.write
description: Write an approved local Markdown memory file.

args_schema.path: optional relative Markdown path such as long-term/facts/personal.md or short-term/task-context.md; use auto/empty to let backend create a title-based path
args_schema.title: optional title used for auto-generated Markdown path
args_schema.memory_scope: long-term for durable memory, short-term for temporary memory
args_schema.ttl_hours: optional short-term TTL from 1 to 48 hours; default 24
args_schema.metadata: optional object with type, source, confidence, memory_scope, ttl_hours
